text: Well, the top of the standings looks like a frozen pond with not a ripple to be seen, Justin Do's JeE-DeY still clinging to the lead by a thread over Torida Té's Mon-Q and La saucisse's Hot Dog, all three seemingly locked in a goaltender duel of inertia. Our biggest mover, and I use that term loosely, is Louis Do's LMD creeping up one spot, proving that consistency, or maybe just the rest of the league standing still, is the key. The bottom rung of the ladder is starting to feel the chill though, with Vincent Daigle's Deagle's Team taking a slight tumble, proving that even the sharpest talons can get a little dulled. I'm calling it now, this week we'll see someone finally break free from the pack, likely after a major trade that will have half the league crying foul and the other half celebrating like they just won the Cup.
